newsitem.title: GERMANY: Opel GM to consider Lada sale proposal.
newsitem.headline: Opel GM to consider Lada sale proposal.

text.p: Adam Opel AG, the German unit of U.S. carmaker General Motors Corp, will review an offer from Russian carmaker Lada to sell a majority stake to Opel, an Opel spokesman said on Monday.
Lada chief Wladimir Kadannikow was quoted in a German newspaper as offering to sell a majority stake in his company to Opel if the German carmaker would make an appropriate investment in Lada.
Kadannikow also again raised the possibility that Opel would produce cars at a AvtoVAZ plant in Togliatti that now makes Lada and Niva cars.
But the Opel spokesman said that Opel had no concrete intention at the moment to sign such a deal with Lada.
Seifert said more solid talks were being held with Finish firm Valmet Automotive. The two companies are studying plans to build a factory to make Opel cars in northwest Russia.
